notes.title: patch note
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002094/ba57b245f68884e188327305056e842a5955afc8.png[/img]

In order to make certain achivements more fluid, the weather conditions are displayed before entering a run.

It will reduce unnecessary grinding for the elemental runs.

The weather will only change over time as you practice your cooking skills.
So after making a receip, weather can change to your behavior.
.
!!The weather conditions affect people!!

Enjoy and stay tuned.
